name: Accept the Claude in Chrome prompt

criteria.chrome_prompt: A heading `Claude in Chrome extension detected`, a short explanation (wording may vary), then two unnumbered options: `No, keep browser tools off` first and `Yes, use my browser` second, usually followed by a hint like `Enter to confirm · Esc to keep browser tools off`. The menu is still waiting for a choice.
criteria.other: Anything else: a different prompt (workspace trust, Bypass Permissions warning, permission to run a command or edit a file); normal conversation; or the Chrome heading only in old scrollback while the session has moved on to a normal input box below it.

question.instructions: The text is the screen of a Claude Code terminal. Decide whether it is currently showing the `Claude in Chrome extension detected` prompt, still waiting for the user to pick an option.
